package gateways

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"example.test/gwapp/internal/domain"
	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	rules "example.test/gwapp/internal/rules/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
)

// RecordAuthEvent appends one authentication event to the audit log of the
// verified tenant, attributed to the verified subject (a user or a machine).
func RecordAuthEvent(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports RecordAuthEventPorts,
	in models.AuthEvent,
) error {
	if !rules.ValidAuthEvent(in.Event) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: event", domain.ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	return ports.Audit.Append(ctx, e, in)
}
